description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Organization identifier, also known as organization ID, in string form. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access URL, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
